top_categories.workout_context: 651 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.

Road-specific control matters at Race Across Benelux. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 651 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Race Across Benelux's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At Race Across Benelux, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
39,042ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
60ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
651 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 39,042ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 651 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
39,042ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Race Across Benelux. Train it until it feels boring.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Race Across Benelux. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.weather: May in Amsterdam to Arlon, plus an Arlon loop, via Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Race Across Benelux. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 651-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Race Across Benelux rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 651 miles of mixed terrain in Amsterdam to Arlon, plus an Arlon loop, via Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.
